comments.regular: Cross-IDB comparison revised: both Oblivion and Fallout contain QueuedTreeBillboard RTTI. Oblivion size/layout is 0x38 bytes/context+0x30; Fallout ModelLoader queue allocates 0x40 bytes/context+0x38 and runs Finish->IOManager postprocess->CreateBillboard. Both originate from missing billboard textures; renderer integration differs.
